title: pekarj/bdbv-pipeline-temp
description: Automated pipeline for downloading, cleaning, and building maximum-likelihood phylogenies from Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) genome sequences hosted on Pathoplexus.

input_options.title: Input Options
input_options.help_text: These are downloaded from Pathoplexus if not provided

organism.title: Organism
organism.description: LAPIS organism slug used for download

scope.title: Download scope
scope.description: Comma-separated list of countries (drc,kenya,uganda) or 'outbreak' for all

fasta.title: Optional FASTA
fasta.description: By default the pipeline downloads sequences from pathoplexus. Alternatively user can provide a FASTA file
fasta.help_text: Pre-aligned from Pathoplexus, or unaligned if using --mafft. If unset, sequences are downloaded from Pathoplexus.

mafft.title: Run MAFFT
mafft.description: Align sequences with MAFFT before cleaning. Not needed for pre-aligned Pathoplexus sequences
mafft.help_text: Not needed for pre-aligned Pathoplexus sequences

metadata.title: Optional Metadata
metadata.description: If using own fasta file, this metadata TSV should be in the same format as provided by Pathoplexus

previous_data.title: Previous data
previous_data.description: Previous run folder to compare against in health checks
previous_data.help_text: Set for update runs; health checks are skipped when unset

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix for output file names (default: bdbv_<run_name>, e.g. bdbv_20261026)

run_name.title: Run name
run_name.description: Label for this run used in downloaded file names and retractions (default: today, YYYYMMDD)

design_options.title: Design Options
design_options.description: Options related to the design of the analysis

min_date.title: Minimum date
min_date.help_text: Sequences from the same year but before this date are flagged.

max_date.title: Maximum date
max_date.help_text: Sequences from the same year but before this date are flagged.

pathoplexus_filters.title: Pathoplexus filters
pathoplexus_filters.description: Optional extra filters for the Pathoplexus download, written like a URL query string: field=value, with & between filters e.g. geoLocAdmin1=Ituri&completenessFrom=0.9

model.title: Substitution model
model.description: Use this model (e.g. GTR+F+R3) with IQTree, or if blank, run ModelFinder

adar_mode.title: ADAR mode
adar_mode.help_text: mask: mask ADAR sites; exclude_tc: exclude T>C genomes; exclude_all: exclude T>C/A>G/G>A genomes. Health checks currently only work with mask.

outlier_removal_threshold.title: Outlier removal threshold
outlier_removal_threshold.description: Auto-remove temporal outliers with |z| >= this value and continue
outlier_removal_threshold.help_text: If neither this nor --outlier_file is given, the pipeline stops after temporal rooting for review

full_health_check.title: Full health check
full_health_check.description: Run health checks on all genomes, not just new ones

review_options.title: Review Options
review_options.description: Options for the manual review points.

outlier_file.title: Outlier file
outlier_file.description: Reviewed outlier exclusion file; continues from outlier filtering
outlier_file.help_text: Needs the earlier run's outputs to continue from: give the earlier run's output folder as 'Continue from earlier outputs' so earlier steps are not repeated. Overrides --outlier_removal_threshold.

resume_from.title: Continue from earlier outputs
resume_from.description: Output folder of an earlier run that stopped for outlier review. Skips every step before outlier filtering
resume_from.help_text: Use with the reviewed outlier file: the pipeline takes the ADAR-masked alignment, the model and the temporal rooting results from this folder and carries on from outlier filtering, so nothing is downloaded or built again and the data you reviewed is the data used. Give the same prefix, run name and ADAR mode as the earlier run. Can be the same as the output directory.

additional_options.title: Additional Options
additional_options.description: These options are available but presets are recommended.

trim_start.title: Trim start
trim_start.description: First alignment position to keep (1-based, inclusive). Earlier positions are masked to N

trim_end.title: Trim end
trim_end.description: Last alignment position to keep (1-based, inclusive). Later positions are masked to N

max_threads.title: Maximum threads
max_threads.description: Upper limit on threads for MAFFT and IQ-TREE. The CPUs of the machine are used up to this number
max_threads.help_text: A machine with fewer CPUs than this uses all of its CPUs, so a small machine is not over-subscribed and a large one is used fully. IQ-TREE tests thread counts up to this limit and keeps the fastest. Results from the same seed can differ slightly between machines that use different numbers of threads; set this to a fixed value (for example 4) if you need identical settings everywhere.

aliases_file.title: Aliases file
aliases_file.description: CSV mapping observed admin2 location names to canonical names

exclude_file.title: Manual exclusions
exclude_file.description: Saved accessions to always exclude from analysis (e.g. non-consortium sequences)

exclude_pending.title: Pending exclusions
exclude_pending.description: Accessions temporarily excluded while under review

mask_sites.title: Mask sites
mask_sites.description: Comma-separated 1-based positions to mask to N (e.g. 5246,5249,5251)

mask_sites_file.title: Mask sites file
mask_sites_file.description: File with 1-based positions to mask, one per line (# comments allowed)
mask_sites_file.help_text: Defaults to data/mask_sites.txt. Use `false` to mask no sites.

linelist.title: Local linelist
linelist.description: Optional local linelist Excel file. Adds duplicate resolution and linelist mismatch checks to the metadata quality report
linelist.help_text: Needs the Pathoplexus ID and Sample ID columns. The metadata quality report runs without it; the linelist adds duplicate resolution against it and date/location mismatch checks. Automatic exclusions from the report (duplicates, quality failures) are applied in the pre-filter either way.

hz_lookup.title: Health zone lookup
hz_lookup.description: Health area/zone/province CSV used by the metadata quality report to detect province names
hz_lookup.help_text: Defaults to data/health_area_zone_province_slim.csv. Use `false` to skip.

slack_webhook.title: Slack webhook URL
slack_webhook.description: Slack incoming webhook to notify when the run finishes or fails
slack_webhook.help_text: Defaults to the SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable. Prefer the environment variable so the URL is not on the command line. The URL is never written to the run log.

miscellaneous_options.title: Miscellaneous Options
miscellaneous_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.
